notes.title: Version 2.1.0 Released
notes.content:
Hi Dancers,

It has been a long time since the last release. It's my pleasure to announce about the new release:
1) All stages are available now, instead of only 1 like before.
2) Add more options in Settings: 
- Adjust lighting
- Change skybox (Few old stages can't be applied).
3) PK Mode is being enhanced so it's not available now.

I'm developing a new release that will add more game interactions. Please be patient with me and all comments/suggestions are most welcome.

Thanks,
Dancing Angel Admin

notes.title: Version 1.3.1 Release
notes.content:
Hi Players,

Sorry for the long delay, I would like to introduce a new mode: Battle Mode. I will answer some questions:

[b]1) Why a Rhythm game has Battle mode?[/b]
Basically, I want to offer the player another option to enjoy my game. You can use your character, your Gold, and Ruby for both modes. That's why instead of creating a separate game for Battle mode, I include it as another option in this game. If you don't like Battle mode, just ignore it and enjoy Dance mode. 

[b]2) Will I develop Battle mode and Dance mode at the same time?[/b]
Yes. Introducing Battle mode doesn't mean that I stop Dance mode development. My main priority is Dance mode always.

[b]3) what is my future plan?[/b]
[list]
[*] Mobile app for this game (Android) and hopefully will release by Christmas.
[*] New Scene for Christmas Event.
[*] Add Christmas songs.
[/list]

Battle mode guide: [url=http://dancingangels.tk/news;action=detail;type=GUIDE;id=5f94e0e83ff18c5d2ba82655]here[/url]

Again, thanks for your support and hope you all enjoy my game.

Thanks,
Dancing Angel Admin
